title: Improving Cross-Cultural Survey Simulation with Calibrated Value Personas
reasoning: The paper specifically benchmarks LLM performance on survey items from the World Values Survey (WVS), which include dimensions of traditional vs. secular-rational values and survival vs. self-expression values. It explicitly measures and analyzes responses to questions about religious importance, religious attendance, confidence in churches, and ethical justifications for actions like bribery, cheating on taxes, divorce, and suicide.
